notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
COOP

Bugs in the loadout system have been fixed.

Fixed audio problems between Client Host

Fixed zombie sounds not coming to client

Fixed client minimap inconsistency

General

Optimization tweaks

DirectX 12 Gpu crash fixed

AI perception and pathfinding tweaks

New injection round added

To make the mission system understandable, the locations to be visited in missions have been marked as a region on the map.

Added a dialog when the character is approaching the location relevant to the mission

Things to do

Issue with health, infection, thirst and hunger bars not updating on the device screen.

Weapon recoil adjustments

Sound effects to indicate the state of the character

Dynamic music system

Feeling improvements

notes.title: Demo Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed client not being able to select weapons in loadout system.

Fixed inconsistency in infected sounds

Added Blaster infected type

Adjustments to the number of infected on the map

Size of subtitles adjusted

Added auxiliary elements related to the quest system

Thank you for all the feedback. We will take care to keep it up to date as we make improvements.

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
New Loadout System: Players can now customize their equipment before entering gameplay.

Gamepad Support (W.I.P.): Initial implementation of controller support; full compatibility is in progress.

New Weapons: Additional weapons have been added to expand combat variety.

New Ambience: Improved environmental audio and visual effects for better immersion.

AI System Enhancements: Enemy behavior has been refined for more dynamic and challenging encounters.

Quest System Improvements: Quest flow and tracking have been optimized for better clarity and usability.

Spawn System Tweaks: Adjustments made to ensure more balanced enemy spawns.

Bug Fixes: Various reported issues have been resolved to improve overall performance.

Thank you for playing and providing feedback. Your input helps us shape the future of the game.
